question: An article was sold by trader at 5.85% profit. Had it been sold at 2.1% loss, it would have given him ₹1,431 less. The cost price ( in ₹ ) of the article is:
solution:
Calculations:

Let the cost price be Rs 100.

SP for 5.85% profit = Rs 100 + 5.85 = Rs 105.85

SP for 2.1% loss = Rs 100 - 2.1 = Rs 97.9

Difference in profit = Rs 105.85 - Rs 97.9 = Rs 7.95

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57d56fd9a69122ea2e80376be81763fe0ceab0d0c30abee19e264c8704a9c76b.png] 

⇒ x = 1431times 100 over 7.95 = Rs 18,000

∴ The cost price is Rs 18,000.
